title: Full LAN + IoT Assessment Chain — Integrated Smart Home and Network Security Assessment
goal: Create an integrated assessment chain that combines all LAN and IoT runners into a phased smart home / enterprise LAN assessment that a consultant can launch in a single wizard step.
scope: Add a new wizard tile 'Smart Home / IoT LAN' (key: smart-home-lan, icon: 🏠🔒) and a corresponding assessment chain FULL-LAN-IOT. The chain executes these phases in order: Phase 1 - Discovery (passive-network-discovery + passive-lan-iot-discovery): host ping sweep + mDNS/SSDP to find all devices including IoT. Phase 2 - Enumeration (passive-network-service-enumeration + passive-lan-nse-full + passive-lan-snmp-enum): port scan with NSE scripts + SNMP walk on port 161. Phase 3 - Service Analysis (passive-lan-smart-home-audit + active-lan-camera-audit): MQTT/Home Assistant testing + ONVIF/RTSP camera testing. Phase 4 - Credential Testing (active-lan-default-creds-audit + passive-lan-smb-enum): default credential testing on found interfaces + SMB enumeration. Phase 5 - Segmentation (passive-lan-segmentation-check + passive-lan-ipv6-discovery): subnet discovery + IPv6 scan. Phase 6 (optional, requires authorization) - Intrusive (passive-lan-infrastructure-audit + intrusive-lan-credential-capture): full infrastructure scan + Responder poisoning. Each phase gate requires operator approval before proceeding. The chain auto-populates inventory with device types: smart-home-hub (Home Assistant), ip-camera (ONVIF devices), iot-gateway (Hue Bridge), network-infrastructure (Unifi AP/switch), consumer-iot (Xbox, Denon, dishwasher). Final report section: 'IoT Security Summary' with device inventory, unauthenticated services, default credentials found, network segmentation status.
generation_reason: All the individual IoT/LAN runners (backlog-132 through 139) need to be orchestrated into a coherent assessment flow. A consultant should be able to select Smart Home / IoT LAN in the wizard and get a complete phase-by-phase assessment of the entire smart home network.
